title: Model Hub subscription quota
description: Rate-limit windows of every hub-held subscription Source, parsed from the vendor's own model-free usage report that the engine reads with the bound grant. A report only: no consumer may feed it back into resolution, admission, or cooldown. It carries parsed fields only, never a grant, token, or raw upstream body. Quota only: a monetary `value` block is reserved for a later contract version and is absent here.

refresh_interval_seconds.description: How often the server re-reads one Source without a forced refresh.

sources.description: One entry per hub-held subscription Source, in Source order.

plan.description: Plan name the vendor reported, when it reports one.

fetched_at.description: When `windows` was read. Null until the first good read.

state.description: ok: fresh windows. stale: the latest read failed and `windows` is the last good snapshot. auth_expired: the vendor refused the grant; `windows` may be the last good snapshot. unsupported: this vendor has no quota report. error: no good read exists yet.

kind.description: session: the shared short window. weekly: the shared weekly window. model_weekly: a weekly window only one model draws on, named by `scope_model`. other: any window the server does not recognise, rendered from `label`.

label.description: Upstream name, whitespace-collapsed and bounded. Display copy for `other`; the UI composes its own copy for the known kinds.

scope_model.description: Present exactly for model_weekly: the upstream model name.
